item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Cricket fraternity reacts as Zimbabwe enter Super 8s after washout vs Ireland, Australia eliminated
item.description: Rain had the final say in the T20 World Cup 2026 Group B clash between Ireland and Zimbabwe on Tuesday (February 17). The match was called off without the toss being held due to rain in Pallekele. With the game being abandoned, Australia bowed out of the tournament in the group-stage while Zimbabwe became the second team from Group B to qualify for Super 8s. item.title: Cricket Australia planning to stage one Big Bash League match in India next season: Report
item.description: Cricket Australia (CA) is planning to stage a Big Bash League (BBL) match in India next season in a bid to tap into the lucrative market there, SEN Cricket reported. According to the report, CA's move is part of a broader strategy to integrate the money-spinning Indian market with the BBL ahead of a near-certain sale of at least two of its eight franchises. Earlier, the Men in Green were asked to boycott the lucrative fixture as an act of solidarity with Bangladesh after the ICC replaced the Tigers with Scotland in the 20-tournament for refusing to travel to India citing 'security concerns'. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: ‘Resolved not to make same mistakes again’- Usman Tariq says Pakistan will do better next time against India
item.description: Pakistan spinner Usman Tariq was much hyped ahead of their T20 World Cup 2026 game against India that happened on February 15. Tariq did well in his first game against the Men in Blue, taking 1/24; however, his side, Pakistan, suffered a humiliating 61-run defeat. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: “Don’t think Bumrah will rest”- India batting coach Sitanshu Kotak ahead of Netherlands game
item.description: Indian batting coach Sitanshu Kotak has confirmed that pacer Jasprit Bumrah is unlikely to be rested for the team’s upcoming T20 World Cup 2026 final group A game against the Netherlands. item.title: Cricket fraternity reacts as Nepal end 12-year wait for T20 World Cup win by beating Scotland
item.description: Dipendra Singh Airee blazed away to an unbeaten half-century as Nepal end their 12-year-long winless run in T20 World Cup with a seven-wicket triumph against Scotland in an inconsequential Group C clash at the Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai on Tuesday (February 17). Opting to bowl, Nepal restricted Scotland to 170/7 despite Michael Jones's 45-ball 71. For Nepal, Sompal Kami (3/25) claimed three wickets while Nandan Yadav (2/34) returned with a couple of scalps. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: “He has his plans sorted,” Sitanshu Kotak dismisses concerns around Abhishek Sharma’s form
item.description: India opener Abhishek Sharma entered the T20 World Cup 2026 with a lot of expectations, having established himself as one of the most explosive batters in the shortest format. However, the southpaw has failed to leave any mark in the showpiece tournament so far. While Abhishek bagged a golden duck in India’s campaign opener against the USA, he missed the second group-stage match against Namibia due to a stomach bug. item.title: ICC considering shifting future global tournaments out of India due to India-Pakistan conflict: Report
item.description: The International Cricket Council (ICC) is considering the option of shifting the future global tournaments out of India due to the ongoing tensions between India and Pakistan, The Age reported on Tuesday (February 17). According to the publication, the apex body is contemplating moving the 2029 Champions Trophy and the 2031 ODI World Cup out of India to avoid logistical complications arising from India and Pakistan’s refusal to play in each other’s countries. item.description: Keeping aside the old rivalry and current geopolitical climate, Indian batting legend Sunil Gavaskar made a 'humanitarian' plea to the Pakistan government to provide World Cup-winning captain Imran Khan with adequate medical care and dignified conditions in line with international standards.
